sentences.text: This dinosaur reached a total body length estimated between 6 and 8 meters.
Its premaxilla formed a broad, expanded beak structure.
Although the beak lacked teeth, it featured a slightly textured surface along the oral margin.
The maxilla housed a dental battery containing approximately 36 tooth positions.
The genus name references the describer's view that this species was the oldest known hadrosaur.
The holotype specimen includes a partial skull, rib fragments, a hand ungual, and a neural arch.
Remains of Protohadros, including ribs and an ungual, were discovered by Gary Byrd in early 1994.
The remains were found at Flower Mound in Denton County, north-central Texas.
The holotype specimen SMU 74582 was recovered from the Woodbine Formation.
Protohadros was first reported in 1996 by Jason Head.
The species Protohadros byrdi was formally described and named by Head in 1998.
The specific name 'byrdi' honors the discoverer Gary Byrd.
In 1997, Yuong-Nam Lee named possible Protohadros tracks as the ichnospecies Caririchnium protohadrosaurichnos.
Researchers suggest the downward muzzle shape indicates Protohadros specialized in low-growing plants.
Its diet likely consisted of vegetation found in floodplains or deltaic zones.
Protohadros may have also consumed aquatic vegetation.
The genus Protohadros was described by Head in 1998.
The type species of the genus Protohadros is Protohadros byrdi.
Protohadros lived approximately 100 to 93.9 million years ago during the early Late Cretaceous.
Fossils of Protohadros have been found in what is now Texas, United States.
The discovery of Protohadros sparked a debate regarding whether hadrosaurids originated in Asia or North America.
